build_davis_dataset_builder: build a TensorFlow Datasets builder for the DAVIS 2017 video object segmentation dataset
create_davis_config: create a DavisConfig builder configuration with full_resolution option for 480p or 1080p video
run_davis_download: run the Davis dataset builder to download and extract the DAVIS 2017 trainval zip archive
generate_davis_examples: generate video segmentation examples from DAVIS JPEGImages and Annotations directories
read_davis_annotation: read DAVIS annotation PNG files as indexed numpy arrays with shape (H, W, 1)
